title: Physicists sculpt 3D light fields to steer electrons into new quantum states
key_facts: University of Oldenburg team led by Matthias Wollenhaupt
Two femtosecond laser pulses of different colours crossed at one point
Light field oscillates in all three spatial directions
Created electronic quantum states previously only described theoretically and made them visible
Possible uses: chiral molecules, light-matter control
quote_evidence: we can generate electronic quantum states that have previously only been described theoretically and also make them spatially visible
We have thus expanded the experimental optics toolkit to include a new class of three-dimensional light fields.
why_it_matters_hint: New experimental tool for quantum control.
notes: Article credits Scienmag (Katie Riggs, 4 Oct 2026); source follows that chain.
